question: buildings >40m bbox -9.23,38.70,-9.14,38.75 count by type avg/max height overall extent
sql:
WITH hits AS (
  SELECT subtype, height, geometry AS geom
  FROM lisbon_buildings
  WHERE height > 40
    AND geometry && ST_MakeEnvelope(-9.23, 38.70, -9.14, 38.75)
)
SELECT subtype,
       count(*) AS n_buildings,
       round(avg(height), 1) AS avg_height_m,
       max(height) AS max_height_m,
       ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_Envelope(ST_Union_Agg(geom))) AS extent_geojson
FROM hits
GROUP BY subtype
ORDER BY n_buildings DESC, subtype;

question: named major roads partially crossing box -9.23 38.70 -9.20 38.73 metres inside each top 15
sql:
WITH box AS (
  SELECT ST_MakeEnvelope(-9.23, 38.70, -9.20, 38.73) AS env
)
SELECT r.names."primary" AS road_name,
       r.class,
       round(ST_Length_Spheroid(ST_CollectionExtract(ST_Intersection(r.geometry, b.env), 2)), 1) AS metres_inside
FROM lisbon_roads r
CROSS JOIN box b
WHERE ST_Crosses(r.geometry, b.env)
  AND r.names."primary" IS NOT NULL
  AND r.class IN ('primary', 'secondary', 'tertiary', 'residential', 'living_street', 'unclassified')
ORDER BY metres_inside DESC NULLS LAST, road_name, r.id
LIMIT 15;

question: religious buildings fully inside -9.16,38.70,-9.13,38.73 name height footprint bbox corners
sql:
SELECT b.names."primary" AS name,
       b.class,
       b.height AS height_m,
       round(ST_XMin(b.geometry), 6) AS min_lon,
       round(ST_YMin(b.geometry), 6) AS min_lat,
       round(ST_XMax(b.geometry), 6) AS max_lon,
       round(ST_YMax(b.geometry), 6) AS max_lat
FROM lisbon_buildings b
WHERE b.subtype = 'religious'
  AND ST_XMin(b.geometry) >= -9.16 AND ST_XMax(b.geometry) <= -9.13
  AND ST_YMin(b.geometry) >= 38.70 AND ST_YMax(b.geometry) <= 38.73
ORDER BY b.height DESC NULLS LAST, name NULLS LAST, b.id;

question: nearest road Casa do Galvão (-9.2033,38.7004) within box -9.2068,38.6977,-9.1998,38.7031 metres
sql:
WITH box AS (
  SELECT ST_MakeEnvelope(-9.2068, 38.6977, -9.1998, 38.7031) AS env
),
b AS (
  SELECT lb.id,
         lb.names."primary" AS building_name,
         ST_Transform(lb.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3763', always_xy := true) AS geom_m
  FROM lisbon_buildings lb
  CROSS JOIN box
  WHERE lb.names."primary" = 'Casa do Galvão'
    AND lb.geometry && box.env
),
r AS (
  SELECT lr.id,
         lr.names."primary" AS road_name,
         lr.class,
         ST_Transform(lr.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3763', always_xy := true) AS geom_m
  FROM lisbon_roads lr
  CROSS JOIN box
  WHERE lr.geometry && box.env
)
SELECT b.building_name,
       nr.road_name AS nearest_road,
       nr.class AS road_class,
       round(nr.d, 1) AS dist_m
FROM b
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT r.road_name, r.class, ST_Distance(b.geom_m, r.geom_m) AS d
  FROM r
  ORDER BY d, r.id
  LIMIT 1
) nr
ORDER BY b.id;

question: track roads envelope; education buildings inside it — name height centre coords
sql:
WITH track_env AS (
  SELECT ST_MakeEnvelope(min(ST_XMin(geometry)),
                         min(ST_YMin(geometry)),
                         max(ST_XMax(geometry)),
                         max(ST_YMax(geometry))) AS env
  FROM lisbon_roads
  WHERE class = 'track'
)
SELECT b.names."primary" AS name,
       b.class,
       b.height AS height_m,
       round(ST_X(ST_Centroid(b.geometry)), 5) AS lon,
       round(ST_Y(ST_Centroid(b.geometry)), 5) AS lat,
       ST_AsGeoJSON(track_env.env) AS filter_envelope_geojson
FROM lisbon_buildings b, track_env
WHERE b.geometry && track_env.env
  AND b.subtype = 'education'
ORDER BY name NULLS LAST, b.id;

question: buildings cut by edge of box -9.185,38.71,-9.165,38.725 id name type
sql:
WITH box AS (
  SELECT ST_MakeEnvelope(-9.185, 38.71, -9.165, 38.725) AS env
)
SELECT b.id,
       b.names."primary" AS name,
       b.subtype,
       b.class
FROM lisbon_buildings b, box
WHERE ST_Intersects(b.geometry, ST_Boundary(box.env))
  AND NOT ST_Contains(box.env, b.geometry)
ORDER BY b.id;
